items.name: Meshy

items.why_en: Introduced Auto-rigging & Animation API in July, allowing users to automatically rig 3D models and apply animations, significantly streamlining workflows.

items.name: Zoo Tools Pro

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio

items.why_en: Updates improved Maya Scene export and Character Revalidation, crucial for pipelines involving AI-rigged characters.

items.name: Tripo
items.why: 此主要版本更新正式發佈,明確包含T-Pose模型與自動綁骨功能,提升3D生成與綁骨的精確度。
items.why_en: This major version update officially released, explicitly including T-Pose Models + Auto-Rigging, enhancing 3D generation and rigging precision.

items.name: MAI-Voice

items.why_en: Microsoft AI's voice model, twice as fast and 32% cheaper than its predecessor, enhancing voice generation efficiency.
